meta.description: Network drives, NAS status and credentials for a small Windows network.
settings.exportIntro: Saves devices, profiles, settings and the list of credentials in a JSON file. Passwords are not included: they only work on this server, for this Windows user.
settings.importIntro: Loads a file exported from this page, here or on another installation. You see what changes before anything is written, and a backup copy of data/ is made first.
settings.modeMerge: Merge: adds and updates by id, removes nothing
settings.modeReplace: Replace: devices, profiles, credentials and settings become exactly those of the file
settings.fileNotJson: The file is not valid JSON.
settings.nothingToDo: Nothing to do: everything in the file is already here.
settings.noPassword: Without a password, to enter in Devices → Credentials (until then nothing uses them):
settings.skippedLineRemoved: Not imported, and the one here is removed: {name}, {reason}
settings.needsRestart: The service reads these settings at startup: restart it after the import.
settings.needsInstallService: Port or task name change: run scripts/install-service.ps1 again, from an elevated PowerShell.
settings.publicAddressChanged: The public address changes: agent installers will point to it.
settings.confirmMerge: Import the file, adding and updating? A backup copy of data/ is made first.
settings.confirmReplace: Replace devices, profiles, credentials and settings with those of the file? What the file does not contain is removed. A backup copy of data/ is made first.
settings.importedRestart: Imported. Backup copy in data/{backup}. Restart the service to use the new settings.
service.restartTitle: Stop and restart the service on the server
service.codeChanged: ⚠ The service code changed after it started: some features may not work until you restart it.
service.confirmRestart: Restart the NAS-Management service? It takes a few seconds; queued jobs and sessions are kept.
service.notBack: The service did not come back within a minute: check the scheduled task or data\service.log.
login.title: Log in
login.hint: The key is shown on the server with
devices.title: Devices
devices.addHint: Adding tries the ports and reads what the device says about itself, without logging in.
devices.addressesLabel: Addresses, comma separated; the first one is the one normally used
devices.metricsAuto: automatic: the user set in config.json, if linked
devices.wolTestTitle: Sends the Wake-on-LAN packet and checks whether the device comes up within 5 minutes
devices.wolMarkedNo: It is marked as "not available": trying anyway.
devices.wolWaiting: {name}: packet sent, waiting for it to come up ({elapsed})… A NAS takes a few minutes.
devices.wolUp: {name}: up after {elapsed}. Wake-on-LAN works and has been marked so.
devices.wolNotUpAsk:
{name} did not come up within 5 minutes.

Mark Wake-on-LAN as "not available"? (It can also depend on other things: power, BIOS or QTS settings.)
devices.wolNotUp: {name} did not come up within 5 minutes.
devices.confirmRemove: Remove {name} from the registry? The credentials stay, without this device.
devices.addedSilent: {name} added: it does not answer, maybe it is off.
cred.title: Credentials
cred.hint: Passwords are encrypted on the server and this page never receives them.
cred.keepEmpty: Leave it empty to keep it unchanged.
cred.confirmRemove: Delete the credential {user} ({id})? The encrypted password is lost.
status.intro1: On or off is checked every minute, without logging in. The metrics of QNAPs that are on are read every 15 minutes with the read-only account, or when you press "Refresh now".
status.intro2: A device that is off is not an error.
status.wakeFailed: Packet sent {when}, but it did not come up within 5 minutes.
status.wakeWaiting: Wake-up requested {when}: waiting for it to answer (up to 5 minutes).
status.noWol: No Wake-on-LAN: it can only be switched on with its button.
status.wolNeverTested: Wake-on-LAN has never been tested on this device.
status.packetSent: Packet sent to {mac}. A NAS takes a few minutes to come up.
map.legendPending: pending change: click a cell to change it
map.legendBar: bar = space used on the volume
map.outsideTitle: Drives to servers not in the registry
map.nothingChanges: No machine changes until you apply.
map.nasUserOne: NAS user (only one per address on this machine)
map.rewrite: write the password again into this machine's Credential Manager
map.rewriteNote: Needed when Windows asks for user and password (error 1223): the password saved on that PC is no longer valid. The agent replaces it with the one from the vault and then mounts.
map.resetTitle: Puts letter, address and user back as they were when you opened this window
map.summaryNote: For each machine a job starts with the snapshot taken before, which can be restored from "Network drives → Jobs". Profiles are saved right away and touch no machine.
map.userUnknownReal: unknown user (the Credential Manager has nothing for this address)
map.userFromManager: credential from the machine's Credential Manager
map.nameNotResolved: on this PC the name does not resolve
map.namePointsToSelf: on this PC it points to {ip}, that is the PC itself
map.namePointsElsewhere: on this PC it points to {ips}, not to the NAS
map.managerNone: no user in the Credential Manager
map.warnUserChange: On {address} the user changes from {from} to {to}. To keep two users, change this letter's address instead.
map.warnUserChangeOthers: On {address} the user changes from {from} to {to}: {letters} are mounted again too (Windows keeps one user per address). To keep two users, change this letter's address instead.
map.warnReplaced: {letter}: today it is {path}: it will be replaced.
map.warnNameProblem: {address}: {problem}. With this address the drive does not reach the NAS: fix the name on that PC (hosts file).
map.warnNameProblemIp: {address}: {problem}. With this address the drive does not reach the NAS: choose {ip}, or fix the name on that PC (hosts file).
map.warnRemountVia: It will be mounted again via {address} instead of {before}.
map.warnSameUser: On this machine {address} uses the user {user}: this letter will use the same.
map.warnSameUserOthers: On this machine {address} uses the user {user} (like {letters}): this letter will use the same.
map.warnNoUserYet: On this machine {address} has no user yet: choose one below.
map.chooseUser: choose the user: this machine's Credential Manager has none for this address
map.chooseSomething: Choose a different letter, address or user, or "Remove the letter".
map.writesPassword: writes the password of {user} for {server} into the PC's Credential Manager
map.waitingAgent: Waiting for the agent of {names}: the agent picks up the job within a minute…
map.agentNotYet: The agent has not run everything yet: the machine may be off or the user not logged in. The job stays queued, you can see it in "Network drives → Jobs".
map.youAreHere: this is the PC you are looking from
map.agentOld: this PC runs agent {version}, the server has {current}
map.volumeUnreadNote: shares used by letters but missing from the last read
map.structureNever: structure never read: it is read when the NAS is on
map.noMachines: No machine has the agent yet: only the letters planned in profiles are shown. Real letters appear as soon as you register machines in "Network drives".
drives.installHint: download the installer and open it with a double click, as the Windows user whose drives you want to manage. You do not need to be an administrator; actually, do not use "Run as administrator".
drives.downloadWarning: The browser may warn that the file is not safe or not commonly downloaded: choose "Keep". Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": "More info", then "Run anyway". This happens because the file is not signed and comes over http.
drives.commandAlt: Alternatively, the command to paste in PowerShell (normal, not administrator)
drives.agentNote: Drives stay mounted even when the agent is stopped: the agent is only needed to receive changes and report the state.
drives.modeAlign: Align: also removes the letters outside the profile
drives.applyNote: Letters ticked as "taken by something else" or "to remove" will be changed. The snapshot is saved first, for restoring.
drives.suspendedNote: A NAS rejected the credential: no agent will try it again until you unlock it. Check the password in "Devices" first, otherwise QNAP blocks the address.
drives.windowsCredentials: Windows Credential Manager (network entries only, without passwords)
drives.displayNamePlaceholder: leave empty for the Windows name
drives.protectedNote: A protected letter is changed or removed only when ticked on purpose in the preview.
drives.preferredLegend: Address to use for each NAS on this machine
drives.profileNote: Shares and folders are picked among those that exist on the NAS. Empty subfolder: the letter opens the whole share. Credential "from the Credential Manager": the one Windows already has on that machine is used. On the same NAS a profile can use only one credential (error 1219).
drives.noMachines: No machines: register one with the button above.
drives.diagTitle: The agent checks how this PC reaches a NAS: name, port 445, Credential Manager, drives. Read-only.
drives.windowsName: Windows name: {name}. The display name only applies in this app.
drives.skippedNotRegistered: Skipped because the server is not in the registry: {list}
drives.confirmRemoveMachine: Remove {machine}? The drives on the machine stay; the agent will no longer be listened to.
drives.codeExpiry: Code {code}: it works once, until {time}. On a machine with several users, repeat for each one, each in their own session, with a new code.
drives.downloadFailedCode: Download failed: {error}. Press "Register a machine" again for a new code.
drives.downloadStarted: Download started. If it does not appear, open Chrome's downloads (Ctrl+J): it may have held it back because it is a .cmd over http; choose "Keep". Then double-click the file.
drives.noProfiles: No profiles: create a new one or start from a machine's snapshot.
drives.confirmDeleteProfile: Delete the profile "{name}"? The machines do not change.
drives.noMachinesApply: No registered machines. Use "Register a machine" in the Machines section above: each one appears here as soon as its agent connects.
drives.agentStoppedQueued: agent stopped, the job will stay queued
diag.title: Network diagnostics
diag.intro: This PC's agent checks how it reaches the chosen server: name resolution, hosts file, DNS cache, port 445, names in the Credential Manager, drives and SMB sessions. Read-only: it changes nothing. The result arrives within a minute, if the agent is online.
diag.agentStopped: This PC's agent is stopped: the diagnostic will start when it is back online.
diag.noAnswer: The agent has not answered yet: the request stays queued, open this again later.
browse.title: Choose the folder
wizard.takenBy: taken by {path}: choose another letter or remove it in the previous step
wizard.noMachines: No registered machines: use "Register a machine" in the Machines section.
wizard.step0Intro: Choose the machines. In the next steps you decide, for each one, what to remove and what to mount.
wizard.step1Intro: Tick the drives to remove. The others stay as they are. Protected letters are used by scripts: remove them only if you are sure.
wizard.noSnapshot: No snapshot: what is there is unknown, nothing to remove.
wizard.step2Intro: Choose the profile drives to mount and, if needed, a different letter for this machine. The profile does not change.
wizard.step3Intro: Before running, the machine's snapshot is saved: you can restore it from Jobs.
wizard.nothingHere: Nothing to do on this machine.
wizard.fixLetter: {machine}: {letter}: fix the letter before going on.
jobs.confirmCancel: Cancel the job? The operations already done stay.
jobs.confirmRestore: Put the machine back as it was before this job?
jobs.confirmUnlock: Unlock? Every agent with a pending job will try again right away: do it only after fixing the password.
installer.comment1: Installs the NAS-Management agent for the logged-in Windows user.
installer.comment3: Run it with a double click, NOT as administrator.
installer.done: Done: the machine appears in the page within a minute. You can close this window.
installer.failed: Installation FAILED: read the message above.
result.alreadyRestored: the machine is already as it was before
msg.credentialSuspended: credential suspended on this NAS after a rejection: unlock it from the page
msg.noPasswordInVault: the credential has no password in the vault
msg.qtsLoginRejected: QTS rejected the login of {user} for metrics
warn.noSnapshot: The machine has not sent its snapshot yet: all letters show as new.
warn.agentOffline: Agent not online (computer off or user not logged in): the job stays queued.
warn.notManaged: The machine is not managed: turn the switch on to apply.
warn.importCredentialDeviceDropped: Credential {user}: the link to {devices} is dropped, the device will not exist.
warn.importMetricsCredentialDropped: Device {device}: its metrics credential will not exist or is not linked to it; the default one is used.
warn.importSharedAddress: The address {address} belongs to two devices.
warn.managerOtherUser: On {server} the Credential Manager has {manager}, the profile uses {user}: drives already open with the other user may give error 1219.
warn.jobWillBeReplaced: It already has a job running: it will be cancelled and replaced.
warn.touchesProtected: Touches protected letters ({letters}): scripts use them.
warn.userChanges: on {server} the user changes from {from} to {to}
warn.userChangesRemount: on {server} the user changes from {from} to {to}: {letters} are mounted again too
warn.willBeReplaced: {letter}: today it is {path}, it will be replaced
warn.machineNotManaged: machine not managed: these changes will not be applied
warn.agentOfflineQueued: agent not online: the job stays queued until the machine connects
warn.profileLetterReplaced: {letter}: in the profile it was {device}\{share}, it is removed
agent.port445: {server} does not answer on port 445: maybe it is off
agent.noCredentialSent: the server did not send the credential
agent.error1219: error 1219: on {server} a session with another user is already open. {error}
agent.invalidOperation: operation refused: letter or path not valid
err.foreignOrigin: request refused: it does not come from this service's pages
err.importNotExport: this is not a file exported by NAS-Management
err.importNewerVersion: the file has format version {version}, newer than this NAS-Management: update it first
err.importModeInvalid: import mode must be merge or replace
err.importDeviceInvalid: device number {n} in the file is not valid (field {field})
err.importCredentialInvalid: credential number {n} in the file is not valid (field {field})
err.importProfileInvalid: profile number {n} in the file has no valid id
err.importConfigInvalid: the settings in the file are not valid: {error}
err.tooManyAttempts: too many attempts: try again in a few minutes
err.noAccessKey: access key not set: on the server run node src/cli.js key
err.restartFailed: cannot prepare the restart: see data/service.log; the service stays on
err.codeExpired: code expired or already used: generate a new one
err.registrationCodeInvalid: registration code invalid or expired: generate a new one from the page
err.agentTokenInvalid: agent token not valid: reinstall it with a new code
err.addressInvalid: invalid address: an IP or a name
err.nameResolvesLoopback: {address} resolves to {ip}: dirty DNS cache, or a DNS that answers 127.0.0.1? Use the IP
err.deviceNotAnswering: {device} does not answer: is it off?
err.needTextList: {field}: a list of strings is needed
err.nameTooLong: name too long: at most {max} characters
err.needAddress: at least one address is needed
err.metricsCredentialNotLinked: the credential for metrics must be linked to this device
err.serverInvalid: invalid server: a name or an IP address
err.machineGone: the machine is no longer registered
err.credentialNotLinked: {letter}: the credential {user} is not linked to {device}
err.twoCredentialsProfile: {device}: the profile uses two different credentials, Windows does not allow it (error 1219)
err.noSnapshotYet: the machine has not sent its snapshot yet
err.notMountedReload: {machine}: {letter}: it is not mounted, reload the page
err.entryNotInProfile: {machine}: entry {entry} is not in the profile
err.letterOccupied: {machine}: {letter}: it is taken by {path}, remove it or choose another letter
err.noRestoreSnapshot: there is no earlier snapshot for this job
err.credentialNotLinkedTo: {letter}: the credential is not linked to {device}
err.needCredential: {machine}: for {letter}: a credential is needed, the Credential Manager has none for {server}
err.folderAccessDenied: {path}: access denied with the server's credentials
err.folderTimeout: {path}: the NAS did not answer within 20 seconds
err.noWol: {name} has no Wake-on-LAN: it can only be switched on with its button
err.noMac: {name}: the MAC is missing in the registry
err.qtsLoginRejected: login of {user} rejected: credential suspended, check it and unlock it
err.qtsSessionRejected: QTS rejects the session it just opened
err.noMetricsCredential: no credential for metrics: link the user {user} to the device or choose one in Devices
err.metricsCredentialSuspended: credential {user} suspended on this NAS: unlock it in "Network drives"
